name: Turkey Fat
imageAlt: rendered pure organic turkey fat in a glass jar
description: Turkey fat is a premium bioavailable lipid substrate with a balanced fatty acid profile comparable to olive oil. Rich in monounsaturated oleic acid, it serves as an efficient metabolic fuel and culinary vehicle that enhances the absorption of fat-soluble nutrients.
macroIntro: A pure, high-density lipid matrix stripped of moisture and protein for maximum metabolic efficiency.
microIntro: A tailored lipophilic matrix providing essential fatty acids and fat-soluble vitamins.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: High-efficiency energy source composed of dense triglycerides.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin E
microNutrients.description: Fat-soluble antioxidant protecting lipid chains from oxidation.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin D3
microNutrients.description: Cholecalciferol traces supporting skeletal and immune regulation.

microNutrients.name: Choline
microNutrients.description: Structural component aiding hepatic lipid transport.

healthBenefits: Cardiovascular Tone: Oleic acid supports healthy lipid profiles.
Nutrient Delivery: Acts as a vehicle for bioavailability of vitamins A, D, E, K.
Thermal Stability: Smoke point (~190-200°C) prevents toxic thermal polymer formation.
Membrane Repair: Provides essential fatty acids for phospholipid bilayers.
Ketogenic Fuel: Carbohydrate-free payload accelerates ketone production.
precautionsIntro: Considerations for caloric management and lipid oxidation:
precautions: Caloric Density: High energy volume requires strict portion control to avoid surplus.
Omega-6 Balance: Significant linoleic acid content requires balancing with Omega-3 intake.
Oxidation Sensitivity: High PUFA content demands cool, dark storage to prevent rancidity.
